name: Mariella Grandback
original_name: マリエラ・グランバック
source:
A famous architect. She likes beautiful buildings and finds them irresistible. She is a perfectionist who will never compromise. She fell in love with the Black Tower, so she decided to live in it.

[Based on the [url=http://www.littlewitch.jp/home/special/LWRQ/pg115.html]official site[/url]]
